name: V3d: latest ramjet ignition that survives CONFIRM-tier fidelity
supersedes: docs/v3c_medium_model/design.json -- V3c (gate 0.44) was verified only at MARCH tier (n_cells 162) and does NOT fly at CONFIRM tier (n_cells 324): peak M 0.257, no cutoff, the 12 deg climb decelerates from M 0.118 to 0.111.

the_fidelity_finding.headline: the answer to 'how late can the ramjet light' DEPENDS ON GRID RESOLUTION, and the MARCH-tier answer is wrong.
the_fidelity_finding.mechanism: the pulsejet loses 3.8-5.5% thrust going 162 -> 324 cells, roughly CONSTANT across the mission Mach range (127.6->120.5 N at M 0.118; 107.8->102.9 at M 0.30; 114.3->109.6 at M 0.44; 111.1->106.8 at M 0.60). The duct sustains at every condition on both grids -- it is not a flame-out, just ~5 N weaker. But late ignition had spent the climb margin down to 0.012 g = 2.7 N, which is SMALLER THAN THE GRID UNCERTAINTY. V3b, carrying 0.049 g = 10.9 N, absorbs the same hit and still passes (0.389 -> 0.352).
the_fidelity_finding.lesson: a margin thinner than the discretisation error of the model that produced it is not a margin. Late ignition is precisely the lever that spends climb margin, so it is the question most likely to be answered wrongly at screening fidelity.
the_fidelity_finding.propulsion_step_refinement: separately, refining the drift triggers at fixed n_cells 162 (dM 0.05 -> 0.03 -> 0.02 -> 0.01) moves traverse MONOTONICALLY 0.3685 -> 0.3795 (+3.0%, a real bias: the staircase UNDERSTATES traverse) while climb margin falls 0.0115 -> -0.0007 and peak Mach and fuel converge. So the staircase flatters climb margin and penalises traverse.

pullout_not_modelled.issue: flight_sim latches v3_dive_done and switches gamma from the dive angle to +1 deg in ONE TIMESTEP. No pull-out arc, no load factor, no g limit.
pullout_not_modelled.cost_at_dive_14: 5.2 g with a 30 m arc, 9.4 g with a 15 m arc, against 15.4 g available at the dive exit (M 0.60, 122 m, q 25167 Pa, CL_max 0.890 section-stall-limited from medium_model/lift.py).
pullout_not_modelled.why_dive_14_not_20: dive 20 needs 9.5 g at a 30 m arc and 18.0 g at 15 m -- the latter exceeds what the wing can produce. Dive 14 is comfortably inside the envelope at either allowance.
pullout_not_modelled.structural: NOT MODELLED ANYWHERE IN THE REPO. At dive 14 / 30 m arc, 5.2 g on a 22.68 kg vehicle is 1157 N (260 lbf) through the wing joint.

known_issues.stale_dry_mass: design.json dry_mass_kg 12.5696 is STALE: recomputing vehicle_dry_mass from this file's own geometry gives 15.4965 kg (+2.927 kg). Independently confirmed by two agents. Inherited from docs/v3_frozen; affects V3a/V3b/V3c/V3d equally since loaded fuel is derived as wet - dry - margin.
known_issues.retracted_235mm: the 235 mm / t-D 4.00 duct recommended in the first V3b report is RETRACTED -- it makes 153 N at M 0.15/60 m but is DEAD (0.94-1.36 N) everywhere the vehicle actually flies. A sustain check at one operating point is not a sustain check.

change: NO GEOMETRY CHANGE from V3a. climb 10 -> 8 deg, dive 9.89 -> 14 deg, floor 133.14 -> 122 m, lightoff gate 0.30 -> 0.40. Ignition is 33% later in Mach than V3b, verified at CONFIRM tier, at traverse 0.283 vs V3b's 0.352 (both CONFIRM). Later ignition buys ignition RELIABILITY: the ramjet lights on ~163 N of thrust at M 0.40 versus ~95 N at M 0.30.
cost_of_late_ignition: climb margin: 0.036 g (gate 0.30) -> 0.019 g (gate 0.40) at CONFIRM tier, because a later gate leaves the pulsejet carrying the vehicle alone for longer.
